```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Snake Game</title>
    <style>
        body {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
            margin: 0;
            background-color: #f0f0f0;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
        }
        #game-container {
            position: relative;
            width: 400px;
            height: 400px;
            border: 2px solid #000;
            background-color: #fff;
        }
        #snake {
            position: absolute;
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            background-color: #00f;
        }
        #food {
            position: absolute;
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            background-color: #f00;
        }
        #score {
            position: absolute;
            top: -30px;
            left: 0;
            font-size: 20px;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="game-container">
        <div id="score">Score: 0</div>
        <div id="snake"></div>
        <div id="food"></div>
    </div>
    <script>
        const gameContainer = document.getElementById('game-container');
        const snake = document.getElementById('snake');
        const food = document.getElementById('food');
        const scoreElement = document.getElementById('score');

        let snakeX = 200;
        let snakeY = 200;
        let foodX = Math.floor(Math.random() * 38) * 10;
        let foodY = Math.floor(Math.random() * 38) * 10;
        let score = 0;
        let direction = 'right';
        let snakeBody = [];

        function updateFoodPosition() {
            foodX = Math.floor(Math.random() * 38) * 10;
            foodY = Math.floor(Math.random() * 38) * 10;
            food.style.left = foodX + 'px';
            food.style.top = foodY + 'px';
        }

        function updateScore() {
            scoreElement.textContent = 'Score: ' + score;
        }

        function checkCollision() {
            if (snakeX < 0 || snakeX >= 400 || snakeY < 0 || snakeY >= 400) {
                return true;
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < snakeBody.length; i++) {
                if (snakeX === snakeBody[i].x && snakeY === snakeBody[i].y) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        function gameLoop() {
            if (direction === 'right') snakeX += 10;
            if (direction === 'left') snakeX -= 10;
            if (direction === 'up') snakeY -= 10;
            if (direction === 'down') snakeY += 10;

            if (checkCollision()) {
                alert('Game Over! Your score: ' + score);
                snakeX = 200;
                snakeY = 200;
                snakeBody = [];
                score = 0;
                updateScore();
                direction = 'right';
            }

            if (snakeX === foodX && snakeY === foodY) {
                score++;
                updateScore();
                updateFoodPosition();
                snakeBody.push({ x: snakeX, y: snakeY });
            }

            snake.style.left = snakeX + 'px';
            snake.style.top = snakeY + 'px';

            for (let i = snakeBody.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                snakeBody[i].x = snakeBody[i - 1].x;
                snakeBody[i].y = snakeBody[i - 1].y;
            }

            if (snakeBody.length > 0) {
                snakeBody[0].x = snakeX;
                snakeBody[0].y = snakeY;
            }

            setTimeout(gameLoop, 100);
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && direction !== 'left') direction = 'right';
            if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && direction !== 'right') direction = 'left';
            if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && direction !== 'down') direction = 'up';
            if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && direction !== 'up') direction = 'down';
        });

        updateFoodPosition();
        gameLoop();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
